decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the continued use of part of ground floor of the single-family house as a health and beauty consultancy, due to its limited scale and nature and because it has not resulted in the loss of a family dwelling, would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the character of the area and would not result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.1 (Presumption Against Loss of Residential), T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the use hereby permitted shall only be carried out within the ground floor front and rear rooms of the ground floor side extension and shall be used as a health and beauty consultancy only and for no other purpose, including any other use within Classes A1, A2 and D1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (As amended) or any subsequent successor legislation.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Mrs Bhullar and no other person and the use shall cease after the property is vacated.
Condition : 4 - The parking provision shown on drawing number GSB/P 001 shall be not be used for any purpose other than  the parking of vehicles and shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
description: Continued use of part of ground floor side extension as a Health and Beauty Consultancy
